Trump seeks control over Smithsonian and health research funding

Former U.S. President Donald Trump sought to exert control over the Smithsonian Institution and health research funding during his administration. He asked his budget chief to draft an order that would bring health research funding under his control. Trump's desire to influence the Smithsonian's future was highlighted as a significant test for the organization's next leader, with reports indicating he faced "political pressure" regarding the institution.
